text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So, what should we do next? You came to 
the amusement park with me last time, so 
today—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy!! You twooo! Nice timing! Care to 
join our BBQ!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It's a lively—party.
Taiki's friends—a lot 
of them—are gathering.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, really!? I'll go, I'll go! Right, 
Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dozens of Taiki Shuttle's friends showed 
up. They grilled meat merrily and enjoyed 
chatting. However...

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Hyah...! I-I'm sorry! I'm in the way 
standing here, aren't I? Excuse me~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "No—the carrots... are burned..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Want some?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Socialize with... everyone. That is 
today's... Mission. However... hmm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Last time, I couldn't do anything for a 
student who was in trouble...
This time, I 
truly want to help.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ……！ “IPPATSUGEI”.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
At Japanese parties... you appeal to 
others with a "party trick." At least... 
so I have heard...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I was very surprised... but 
it certainly seems like it would make her 
feel approachable. Not bad. No, isn't it 
actually a brilliant idea...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the risk of bombing is too high. 
Besides, she's not accustomed to these 
customs anyway. In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "ZENZA"...! Oh... how dependable—
choice_data_list: I'll go do the opening act!
I'll go do the opening act!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. Huh, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Steeling myself,
I stepped forward to grab 
everyone's attention. Then, I pointed to 
the treehouse behind me.
choice_data_list: Time for a party trick! I'm gonna ...

text_block_list.name: BBQ Participants
text_block_list.text:
—Eh, what's this? A party trick? —Whoa, 
she's actually climbing it!
choice_data_list: Here's my quick stunt! I'll climb ...

text_block_list.name: BBQ Participants
text_block_list.text:
—W-Whoa there... —Ahaha, I wondered what 
happened all of a sudden. —Good work out 
there~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I see—understood. Then—allow me to fire 
the second shot...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Hah!

text_block_list.name: BBQ Participants
text_block_list.text:
—Oh! That's an amazing acrobatic move! 
—WOOOOOOO! Yeah! —Ahaha,
maybe I should do 
something next!?

text_block_list.name: BBQ Participants
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san, that was amazing! You looked 
so cool~! I took a video just now,
so I'll 
share it with you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Thank you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Good work today, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You looked great. Thanks to that,
it seems 
like we've found a good breakthrough.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And with that... Here you go! You haven't 
had any meat yet, right? I saved some for 
you, so let's eat together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――Eventually, the barbecue wound down,
and 
Bubble Gum Fellow and I headed home 
together.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, we ate so much. Taiki's friends were 
all such fun people too... Hehe,
today was 
a blast, wasn't it?
choice_data_list: Ah, that was so much fun!
Yeah, that was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, we ate so much. Taiki's friends were 
all such fun people too... Hehe,
today was 
a blast, wasn't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Glad to hear that♪
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This strategy will work!" I thought back 
then. It was a firm, unshakable 
confidence... and so I moved without 
hesitation. She must always feel this way.
choice_data_list: I think I might understand how you...
I think I might understand how you...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...! Fufufu, so that's what you were 
thinking.
choice_data_list: I want to become someone with real...
I want to become someone with real...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I think that's great! Hey, why not try 
saying it out loud next time? Just like I 
always do...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see... Today, I certainly lacked the 
confidence to make such a declaration.
Her 
words left a deep, lasting impression on 
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
Perhaps it's thanks to how hard 
you worked to hype things up?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, you're being modest again. I know 
the truth.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I was watching closely, so I noticed you 
were a little different from usual, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You're capable of it. I think you should 
have more confidence in yourself. Like, 
try making a declaration just like I
do... 
you know!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Can I really carry myself with that much 
confidence? Though the thought crossed my 
mind, I merely gave a small nod. She 
praised me, so I should have faith in 
myself!
